title: ProgramIR node set v0 (SEM-8)
description: The forward grammar's JSON encoding, spec/node-set.md SEM-8 ruling: the observed encoding of examples 13-15 adopted as node_set v0 -- the `node` discriminator, the statement/expression vocabulary below, leaves as {leaf: {kind, ref?}} with the interpreter leaf carrying a required ref (D-029; the examples' unnamed singleton is pre-ratification, the migrator adds ref: 'main'), dynamic tools as {leaf: {kind: 'tool'}, name: <expr>}. Artifact form carries no source spans (SEM-8: refusal locations are an input-side concern). The root of this schema is one forward object -- the input to the node_compile op (harness/PROTOCOL.md). Anything outside this closed vocabulary refuses at compile with PIR-E-NODE-* (spec/errors.md).

identifier.description: A simple name. Assignment targets are simple names only (spec/node-set.md SEM-5 ruling: subscript and tuple targets refuse at compile).

forward.description: One module's forward, spec/manifest.md component 5: the language tag, the argument names, and the statement body (spec/node-set.md SEM-8 v0 envelope, from examples 13-15).

language.description: The v0 language tag adopted by SEM-8 from the observed corpus. The vocabulary is this contract's own, operationally defined and CPython-independent, despite the historical name.

args.description: The forward's declared input names ('self' excluded), SEM-8 v0 envelope.

body.description: The statement list; at least one statement (a forward must produce its Prediction via Return, spec/node-set.md statement whitelist).

statement.description: A whitelisted statement, spec/node-set.md statement whitelist, discriminated on `node`. v0 statements: Assign, Return, If, For, While, Break, Continue, Try, Raise. Note: IfExp and BoolOp appear in the whitelist table but have NO observed v0 encoding in examples 13-15 and are therefore absent here -- admitting them is an additive versioned act (see schema/README.md).

expression.description: A whitelisted expression, discriminated on `node`. v0 expressions: Call, Attr, Var, Const, Compare, BinOp (spec/node-set.md SEM-8; SEM-4 pins the operator subsets).

stmt_assign.description: Assign: thread values between leaf calls (spec/node-set.md whitelist). Target is a single simple name (SEM-5 ruling); no attribute/global mutation.

target.description: The bound name, SEM-5 ruling: simple names only.

stmt_return.description: Return: the module output, a Prediction (spec/node-set.md whitelist; PIR-013: Prediction fields = declared output fields exactly).

value.description: The returned expression. v0 encodes this as an expression node (examples 13-15); the bare-string form of example 01 is pre-v0 and fails here.

stmt_if.description: If: data-dependent branch (spec/node-set.md whitelist). The test must evaluate to a boolean at runtime; any other value raises InterpreterTypeError -- no truthiness table (SEM-1 ruling).

test.description: The condition; boolean at runtime per SEM-1 ruling.

body.description: The then-branch; non-empty (the source form cannot author an empty block and v0 has no pass node).

orelse.description: The else-branch; may be empty (observed form always carries the key).

stmt_for.description: For: bounded loop (spec/node-set.md whitelist). v0 iterates range(<non-negative int literal>) ONLY -- the compiled form; list iteration is a future additive change (SEM-2 ruling). Bounded by its literal (SEM-6 ruling). for/else is not representable.

target.description: The loop variable, a simple name (SEM-2/SEM-5).

range.description: The literal iteration count: range(<non-negative int literal>), SEM-2 ruling.

stmt_while.description: While: condition-driven loop (spec/node-set.md whitelist). Boolean test per SEM-1. Interpretation-side default cap of 1000 iterations; breach raises LoopCapError, a harness guard NOT catchable by program handlers (SEM-6 ruling -- v0 carries no per-loop override field). while/else is not representable.

test.description: The condition; boolean at runtime per SEM-1 ruling.

stmt_break.description: Break: exit the innermost loop (spec/node-set.md whitelist).

stmt_continue.description: Continue: next iteration of the innermost loop (spec/node-set.md whitelist; emitted by the ex-15 reference compiler, hence in the v0 observed vocabulary).

stmt_try.description: Try: error + recovery flow over typed errors (spec/node-set.md whitelist; SEM-3 ruling). try/finally and try/else are not representable (v0, per the ex-15 compiler).

handlers.description: The handler list; at least one (a Try without handlers is meaningless in v0 -- no finally/else forms).

except_handler.description: One except clause. Handler matching is exact name, or 'Exception' which catches every table error -- including Raise'd ones, which flow through the same channel as leaf errors (SEM-3 ruling). Binding the caught error to a name is not representable (v0).

type.description: The caught type: the SEM-3 typed-error table plus 'Exception'. LoopCapError is deliberately absent -- it is a harness guard, never catchable (SEM-6 ruling). The runtime-raised InterpreterTypeError/InterpreterKeyError (SEM-1/SEM-7) are not in the table; whether they are catchable by exact name is an unresolved spec tension recorded in schema/README.md -- until ruled, only 'Exception' can catch them.

stmt_raise.description: Raise: throw a typed error (spec/node-set.md whitelist). Raise-able names are restricted to the SEM-3 table -- an unknown name is a compile refusal, never a runtime fallback. Only the `raise SomeError(<constant>)` source form is representable (ex-15 compiler); example 14's `ValueError` is pre-ratification and fails here (see schema/README.md).

exc.description: The raised type: exactly the SEM-3 typed-error table.

message.description: The constant carried by the raise (the ex-15 compiler admits any constant; observed messages are strings). Carried data only -- refusal/trace comparison never matches message text (spec/errors.md discipline).

leaf.description: A Call's declared leaf: {kind, ref?} (SEM-8 ruling). Every Call resolves to a declared, typed leaf -- Predict, sub-module, tool/UDF, or interpreter -- or compile refuses naming the call (spec/node-set.md leaf rule; PIR-E-NODE-002). Kind-specific ref requirements are enforced on the Call node ($defs/expr_call).

kind.description: The leaf type, spec/node-set.md leaf rule.

ref.description: The declared target: a child Predict name (kind=predict), a sub-module name (kind=module), a component-6 tool name (kind=tool, static form), or a component-7 interpreter pool entry name (kind=interpreter; REQUIRED by D-029 -- the examples' ref-less interpreter leaf is pre-ratification; the migrator adds ref: 'main').

expr_call.description: Call: invoke a declared leaf (spec/node-set.md leaf rule). Arguments are keywords only -- positional args and **splat are not representable (ex-15 compiler; example 01's args: '**inputs' is pre-v0 and fails). Dynamic tool dispatch (tools[name](...)) is the model-dispatched call convention: {leaf: {kind: 'tool'}, name: <expr>}, unknown names raising a catchable typed ToolError (SEM-8 ruling).

kwargs.description: Keyword arguments: name -> expression. Always present, possibly empty (the observed v0 form).

name.description: Dynamic tool dispatch ONLY: the expression evaluating to the tool's name at runtime (SEM-8: dynamic tools as {leaf: {kind: 'tool'}, name: <expr>}). Forbidden on every other leaf kind -- enforced by the allOf below.

allOf.description: predict/module/interpreter leaves: ref required (D-029 for interpreter), dynamic `name` forbidden.
tool leaves: exactly one of static ref (leaf.ref, no `name`) or dynamic dispatch (`name`, no leaf.ref).

oneOf.description: Static tool call: leaf names a component-6 entry.
Dynamic (model-dispatched) tool call: name expression, no ref.

expr_attr.description: Attr: field access on a Prediction/record held in a variable -- only simple `var.field` access is representable (ex-15 compiler; SEM-7 ruling: key lookup, a missing key raises typed catchable InterpreterKeyError, never a raw host exception).

obj.description: The variable name holding the record. NOTE: a bare name string, not an expression node -- the v0 observed encoding.

expr_var.description: Var: read a bound name. An unbound Var raises InterpreterKeyError (SEM-7 ruling).

expr_const.description: Const: a literal. Values flowing between leaves are JSON values, Prediction records, and typed errors (SEM-7 ruling); v0 literals are the JSON scalars -- container literals have no observed encoding.

value.description: The literal value, a JSON scalar (SEM-7; int/float distinction follows the serde profile, PIR-004).

expr_compare.description: Compare: single eq/ne comparison (spec/node-set.md whitelist, closed operator subset). SEM-4 ruling: eq/ne is JSON-value equality; different JSON types are unequal, never an error. Chained comparisons and other operators are not representable in v0.

op.description: The comparison operator, SEM-4 ruling's closed subset.

right.description: Right operand (exactly one comparator in v0).

expr_binop.description: BinOp: binary operation. SEM-4 ruling: `add` ONLY -- string+string concatenation or number+number addition; any other operand pairing raises InterpreterTypeError at runtime. Other operators refuse at compile.

op.description: The only v0 binary operator (SEM-4 ruling).
